title: Tiny, cute island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='40' ry='8' fill='#2f8fe0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='19' ry='6' fill='#ffe89a'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#d9ad45' opacity='0.5'/>

  <path d='M50 70 Q46 58 44 46 Q43 40 46 36' fill='none' stroke='#a6652f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='45' cy='39' r='2.8' fill='#8a4b1e'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#6e3a16'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='2.2' fill='#8a4b1e'/>

  <path d='M64 71 l1.5 -3 l1.5 3 l3 0.5 l-2 2 l0.5 3 l-3 -1.5 l-3 1.5 l0.5 -3 l-2 -2 z' fill='#ff7b6b' stroke='#ffb0a5' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <ellipse cx='30' cy='75' rx='3' ry='1.2' fill='#bde9ff' opacity='0.8'/>
